misprints.note: Genomblöt: ρ and γ transposed in the print.
Genomfrysa: the print has ο where υ belongs.
Genomfara, διάττειν (äfv. om kslor): the print clearly reads kslor, which is not a Swedish word.
There is no breathing on α after the bracket. This is probably intended because of the bracketed prefix, so it is kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The full stop before the colon is a broken or dropped piece of type below the line. It is read as '.:'.
There is a space before the colon in the print and no visible full stop, so it is written as a plain colon.
The circumflex sits at the bottom edge of the previous strip's image and is taken to belong to this word.
